pathway.title: LQD · historical ARCC portfolio decision
pathway.question: What do the historical holdings and debate support, and what must be resolved before implementation?

runs.text: Final Sizing Posture: Requires More Work. The decision is driven by real held exposure and conditional losses alongside missing same-date compensation, mandate, loss-budget and execution evidence, because known marked value and small NAV share do not establish permissible risk capacity or executable proceeds, which implies no supported portfolio implementation or new size.

Canonical translation: Requires More Work → Requires More Work. Neither wins the allocation decision. RV has useful measured evidence but no supported inclusion case; Compliance identifies the evidence needed to test it but proves no actual binding breach or adverse risk-adjusted compensation. This is a definite evidence-based posture, not Include, Avoid, Resize or Maintain-Hold. Existing ownership alone supplies none of those decisions.

Overall, ARCC's five reported LQD holdings are Requires More Work for portfolio implementation. The sizing posture is driven by real held exposure and measurable conditional losses alongside missing same-date selection, mandate, depth and loss-budget evidence. Those gaps matter because known marked value does not establish executable proceeds or available risk capacity. The2029 grouping and common issuer risk merit monitoring; the top next action is matching holdings/limits and implementation evidence, not a numeric addition. CP-3B full gate remains blocked. The scoped holdings/exposure/sensitivity functions are completed with limitations; no full CP-3B or CP-3 pass is asserted.

Pre-debate, the central portfolio controversy is whether unestablished spread/ yield/RV evidence could justify an implementation posture when real held exposure/loss transmission is known but mandate, budget, complete downside and execution evidence are missing. H6's Requires More Work is a starting restriction, not a persona's automatic win. No additional issuer credit view is introduced.
Defense does not turn absence of a demonstrated breach into demonstrated compliance. It offers no new RV claim, additional trade, probability or fund cap.

Exact Portfolio Constraint: [Insufficient Information]. One unresolved constraint field; no binding fund limit is asserted. Evidence: H3 supplies matched holdings/NAV but no dated mandate, rule, bucket capacity or loss budget. Risk Mechanic: without the relevant explicit limit and matched exposure, remaining permissible size cannot be calculated. Credit / Portfolio Implication: Insufficient Information; neither within-limit sizing nor a breach/trim follows. Evidence Needed to Resolve: actual dated LQD mandate/risk policy with issuer, sector/rating/factor/downside constraints and matching portfolio mapping. Data quality is the present decision gap; it is not a substitute fund limit.

LQD reported 33,773,000 USD par of five ARCC notes at a combined 33,762,233.40 USD value, 0.109532894% of matching fund NAV. This measures the named issuer's held exposure; a small NAV share alone does not prove unused capacity, diversification compliance or easy exit. Two notes maturing in2029 account for 17,698,117.83 USD, 52.419866957% of this issuer holding's value; this is the fund's ARCC maturity grouping, not ARCC's total refinancing wall.

A purely conditional40%-of-par recovery assumption implies a20,253,033.40 USD loss against the held market value, 6.570576451 fund-NAV basis points. No fund loss budget is supplied, so this is loss transmission, not risk-budget utilization or an actual recovery forecast. The useful next step is to obtain same-date selection/terms, mandate, trading and budget evidence, rather than turn held amounts or historical evaluated values into a proposed trade.

Compliance Attack Summary: the attack defeats unsupported implementation inferences, rather than proving an adverse portfolio position. It cannot claim a concentration/CCC/mandate breach without the actual rule and matching exposure. Country/currency, sponsor and instrument-type caps are likewise untested, not silently cleared. Maturity grouping is fund exposure, not the issuer's whole refinancing wall. No quantitative risk-budget consumption is established.

- RV1 — spread / YTW / DM pickup. Evidence: [Insufficient Information]; H3 has no matching May2025 market/peer spread or yield. Risk Mechanic: a claimed pickup cannot be separated from tenor, credit, optionality or liquidity without actual comparable compensation. Credit Implication: Insufficient Information; no portfolio-yield enhancement claim. Monitoring Signal: obtain same-date, same-basis instrument and peer observations before making this pitch; no source-supported numeric trigger is available. - RV2 — instrument mispricing. Evidence: H3 binds the July2029 holding to US04010LBG77,10,247,000 USD par and10,424,576.41 USD value. Actual mispricing versus seniority/recovery/tenor is [Insufficient Information]. Risk Mechanic: source identity and a marked value permit targeted comparison; a premium to par alone does not establish overvaluation, protection or liquidity. Credit Implication: Insufficient Information; no preferred-note claim. Monitoring Signal: obtain matching operative terms, compensation basis and recovery/exit evidence. Earlier December2024 pricing is not substituted. - RV3 — portfolio implementation. Evidence: H3 reports33,773,000 USD par, 33,762,233.40 USD value across five ARCC notes,0.109532894% NAV. Its assumed 40%-par scenario loss is20,253,033.40 USD/6.570576451 NAVbp; a separate−10% price assumption gives3,376,223.34 USD/1.095328938 NAVbp. Risk Mechanic: the measured holding has a limited fund-NAV footprint under these specified assumptions; that can frame a budget comparison once the actual budget is available. Credit Implication: Neutral — Stable, solely for describing the reported position; implementation eligibility/yield contribution remain [Insufficient Information]. Monitoring Signal: recompute on a matched new holdings/NAV observation and compare with an actual mandate/budget; nothing here supplies a new size, cap or authorization to maintain/add.

blocks.title: What changed since the last Report

runs.text: Cleared for delivery within the stated historical restricted scope. CP5-P01/ P02 are closed; original missing market/mandate/budget/ratings/depth/full downside/ legal/funding evidence remains. It is accurate to publish a useful measured portfolio debate whose final implementation posture is Requires More Work. It is inaccurate to present this as independent review, current approval, a positive binding-constraint test or a full native/provider/CP-OS pass.
